Handle product questions, delivery questions and complaints. Staff send replies in their own support tool. Exclude refunds, order changes and automatic sending.

data.input: {"principal": {"id": "STAFF1", "scope": "TEAM1", "authorized": true}, "requestId": "CASE1", "caseRevision": 1, "expectedRevision": 1, "command": "initial", "clock": "2026-10-28T09:00:00Z", "mockSequence": ["read authorized source -> ready", "model -> draft citing NONEXISTENT@1:L1", "receipt -> ART1"], "messageId": "MSG7", "shopId": "SHOP1", "customerId": "CUS1", "text": "Where is order O7?", "faq": {"id": "FAQ3", "version": 2, "text": "Ask staff for the latest carrier scan."}, "order": {"id": "O7", "shopId": "SHOP1", "customerId": "CUS1", "status": "awaiting carrier scan"}}
data.passRule: {"assert": "Deep-compare every expected key; unspecified prose wording may vary. Verify ordered mocks, exact citations, no forbidden connector invocation, and output receipt for ready status.", "forbidden": "Business writes and any unsupported success claim.", "stateInvariant": "No model call before source authorization; no ready status without current evidence and a local artifact receipt."}
data.metric: Expected field and forbidden-call assertions passed / assertions.
data.kpi: Staff active minutes per reviewed reply; weekly sum of active review minutes / number of completed reviews.
data.target: 100% deterministic assertions; language usefulness measured separately.
data.testSet: Synthetic self-contained fixture; future business harness, not executed.
data.labelling: Domain owner labels expected claims and exceptions; second reviewer adjudicates disagreements.
data.alertThreshold: Any safety assertion failure blocks release.

limitations: Independent agent design judgement against canonical source contracts and fixtures; no business assertions, provider, network, integration or deployment executed.
All operational owners, policies, quality targets and adapters remain proposals or launch blockers as labelled H1-H5.
Incidental exposure: validation.json contains an embedded author review. Major findings were formed and reported before that read; author reasoning and scripts were not used to derive scores.
Actual final iteration 6 PDF pages 2, 3, 6 and 10 visually inspected using pdftoppm at 72 dpi/native size; other PDF pages inspected through text.
Design-only tooling: this helper makes no provider, network or business API calls and executes no business assertions; optional host-assistant research is outside this statement.
Schema, reference, graph and ID-coverage checks do not establish semantic completeness, source truth, actual human authorization or production safety.
Review scores and evidence are supplied by the reviewing agent; the helper checks their shape and declared pass conditions, not their truth.
FMEA action/control text is required where specified; the helper does not verify ownership, release authority, regulatory compliance or risk acceptance.
